tldr: The Moon in Scorpio: emotional nature is intense, private, and hard to soothe casually.
body: With the Moon in Scorpio, the emotional life runs deep and guarded. You need trust before softness feels safe, and the Moon is in fall here, so feelings can become extreme until they are named honestly.
gift: Crisis perception, emotional endurance, loyalty, investigative instinct, and the capacity to stay present with what others avoid.
challenge: Jealousy, brooding, secrecy, suspicion, or turning emotional intensity into control battles.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
